rejectedBeats: The rite is done. The spiralgrass lies dark beneath every foot.
No one moves to leave. The air holds the shape of the last words spoken.
Julian keeps the Answer in his hands. The object does not glow or speak.
Seren checks her hands as though they might reveal what she has already given.
The presiding Dohkar finds his place again and continues without comment.
Julian's gaze finds me before any sound gives him reason.
Here and there someone shifts weight or begins to turn and then stops.
The assembly watches me without asking a single question aloud.
I feel the weight of every unasked question settle on the sash at my mouth.
No one names the interference. The silence keeps its shape.
Seren remains kneeling, her poise unbroken by the eyes now turned toward me.
The Dohkar's words continue, but the attention has already left the rite.
Julian has not moved. The Answer rests in his hands as though it belongs there.
I watch the grass darken and know the assumption is already forming.
No one will ask me to explain. They will only remember that I stood here sealed.
The choice sits between my teeth and the cloth that keeps them still.
Claim the interference and the standing I have built begins to crack.
Stay silent and the assumption hardens into fact before the grass cools.
Julian's stillness gives nothing away. The Answer remains in his hands.
The assembly waits without speaking. The choice is already mine to break.
I feel the seal press against my lips and know the words are still possible.
Seren does not look up. The grass remembers every offering laid upon it.
The Dohkar finishes the final formula. The rite is complete and the question remains.
I stand sealed in the center of the clearing with every eye still on me.
The choice is here now. Speak or let the assumption stand.
